outcome: Pelvic floor muscle function (assessed by digital palpation, vaginal manometry, and surface electromyography)
cohort: 60 women aged 18-40 years, divided into three groups: nulliparous (n=20), primiparous with vaginal delivery (n=20), and primiparous with cesarean delivery (n=20).
finding: There was no significant difference in pelvic floor muscle function between primiparous women and nulliparous women, regardless of mode of delivery.
